answer: Vouch-slot bond: one identity, one orchard plot. Each member holds 3 vouch tokens per epoch, expiring; each is a signed thread in the public nebula ledger. A newcomer needs 2 threads from 2 sponsors and a 70-credit bond to claim an orchard plot. A reused or rented thread burns the bond and halves its sponsor's quota. Filings 38+5(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 2,535,500 plus 70,000 locked against a 40,000 pool. Honest filers pay 38 once and keep the bond.
